intervals.locator: arXiv:2312.17573, Introduction (first physics run in 2023 with a Xe beam); 64th PAC PP report: ninth physics run recorded 2.75 billion events
intervals.note: The detector paper dates the "first physics run" to 2023 with a xenon beam; earlier runs with carbon, argon and krypton beams exist (the Lambda paper uses carbon-beam data) but their dates are not in the sources fetched, so the start is the earliest documented run. The June 2026 report counts a ninth physics run (Xe + Sn, 2.75 billion events) after an eighth run (Xe + CsI).
